title: AI Chat Billing System: interactive demo
description: Interactive synthetic demo of an AI chat billing pipeline: token metering, cost by thread and model, and an invoice builder.
intro: The AI Chat Billing System is a proof-of-concept for tracking and billing AI chat thread interactions with real-time cost metrics and analytics. It addresses the challenge of monitoring and billing AI model usage in chat-based applications, where understanding cost is critical for business planning.

The project provides token usage tracking and cost calculation, thread and message level cost breakdown, invoices, and an analytics dashboard with a 15-second refresh target. It is built from a FastAPI backend, an event collector, a Streamlit dashboard, Kafka, Redis and SQLite.
This page is an interactive demo of those ideas. It uses clearly labelled synthetic data and runs entirely in your browser.
features: Simulated chat threads with token counts per message
Metering pipeline view: ingest, aggregate, dashboard
Cost by hour, thread and model with accessible tables
Steady, spike and runaway-thread scenarios with a seed
Invoice builder with CSV export and print view
demo_notice: All data is synthetic and the demo runs entirely in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere. Figures are not the project's real metrics.
